get.summary: File content as base64 in JSON
Live change feed (created / updated / deleted) for the mock data
get.description: Starts with `event: subscribed`, then one event per change made through any protocol (/v1, /soap, the back office). `event` is the change type, `id` increases; reconnecting with Last-Event-ID replays missed events from a buffer (`event: reset` when the id is too old). Comment heartbeats keep the stream open.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Comma list: employees, products, departments, categories

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Resume after this id (EventSource sends it on reconnect)

parameters.name: dropAfter
parameters.description: Cut the connection after this many events (test reconnect + Last-Event-ID)

parameters.name: malformedAt
parameters.description: Send event N as a broken frame

parameters.name: skipIds
parameters.description: Make event ids jump (test gap handling)

schema.description: A stream of Server-Sent Events (id, event, data lines). data is JSON unless noted.

post.description: Answers with one event per word. `format: "events"` sends `event: message` `{"index", "delta"}` and a final `event: done`; `format: "openai"` sends chat.completion.chunk objects and `data: [DONE]`.

post.summary: Register a client (RFC 7591 dynamic client registration)
post.description: Open registration: no credentials needed. Returns the client_id (and client_secret unless token_endpoint_auth_method is "none") plus a registration_access_token for the management endpoint. Scopes are limited to: read, write.

401.description: Missing or wrong initial access token (OAUTH_REGISTRATION=token)

get.description: Send the registration_access_token from the registration response as `Authorization: Bearer …`.

401.description: Missing or wrong registration access token

delete.description: Send the registration_access_token as `Authorization: Bearer …`. The client can no longer get tokens.

401.description: Missing or wrong registration access token

s3.description: Present on files written through the S3-compatible API: the object key, its ETag (MD5, or MD5-of-parts for multipart), user metadata and stored headers.

redirect_uris.description: Required for authorization_code. Loopback http redirects match on any port (RFC 8252); custom schemes are allowed.

scope.description: Space-separated; must be within OAUTH_REGISTRATION_SCOPES (default: all of them)

XForceError.name: X-Force-Error
XForceError.description: Force an error: a 4xx/5xx status or one of malformed-json, truncated-body, empty-body, wrong-content-type, slow-drip, timeout, reset

XForceStatus.name: X-Force-Status
XForceStatus.description: Override the response status (>= 400 returns a problem+json)

XForceLatency.name: X-Force-Latency
XForceLatency.description: Add this many milliseconds of latency (max 120000)

XCorrelationIdHeader.name: X-Correlation-Id
XCorrelationIdHeader.description: Echoed back; defaults to the request id

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Replays return the original response; reuse with a different body returns 409

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: ETag from a previous GET; 412 on mismatch

Sort.name: sort
Sort.description: Comma list; prefix with - for descending, e.g. -createdAt,lastName

Q.name: q
Q.description: Case-insensitive text search across all fields

IdempotentReplayed.description: "true" when the response is a replay

Link.description: RFC 8288 pagination links (first, prev, next, last)

E409.description: Conflict (idempotency key reuse or resource in use)
